acquisition-acquisition:ashbyhq:ab5a42d9.description: ABOUT ACQ MEDIA ACQ Media is the in-house media engine behind Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com and its portfolio of brands led by Alex Hormozi, Leila Hormozi, and Sharran Srivatsaa. Our mission is to build the leading business media organization in the world by 2030. We produce high-performance long-form series, podcasts, and daily social content that reach millions of people around the globe. Our content is not vanity media, it is designed to drive measurable reach, deepen brand influence, and create downstream business impact across the entire Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com ecosystem. We operate like a studio, not a startup content team. That means structured workflows, batch production, clear performance metrics, and an aggressive commitment to innovation, especially through AI-native production systems. We are building a repeatable content machine that compounds: more output, higher quality, faster iteration, stronger monetization, and deeper brand equity over time. If you’re joining ACQ Media, you’re not here to just make content. You’re here to help build a media powerhouse. ROLE: We’re hiring a Social Media Producer to lead the growth and performance of the social ecosystem behind ACQ Media and the personal brands of Alex Hormozi, Leila Hormozi, and Sharran Srivatsaa. This role is for someone who has scaled meaningful accounts and can point to measurable results. ACQ Media is the in-house media engine producing long-form series, podcasts, and daily short-form content that reaches millions globally. Our media is engineered to drive measurable brand growth and downstream business impact, not vanity engagement. We operate like a studio with structured workflows, batch production, performance metrics, and AI-native systems. In this role, you will own the strategy, editorial direction, and performance of all short-form and platform-native content. You will turn long-form episodes into high-retention, high-distribution assets that drive traffic back to YouTube and strengthen the overall brand ecosystem. You are the bridge between production and distribution, responsible for ensuring speed, cohesion, and measurable impact. This is a management role based in Las Vegas. You will directly manage the Social Coordinator, own the publishing pipeline, and build repeatable systems that compound over time. We are looking for a growth-minded operator who understands platforms deeply, actively integrates AI into workflows, and treats social as a performance channel. RESPONSIBILITIES: - Own the end-to-end social growth strategy across all platforms, translating long-form content into high-performing short-form assets that drive traffic, retention, and measurable brand growth. - Lead and develop the Social Coordinator, setting strategic direction while ensuring disciplined execution of the publishing calendar and platform distribution. - Identify high-retention moments within long-form content and provide clear editorial direction to editors to maximize performance and cohesion. - Build and optimize repeatable production systems, including AI-driven workflows that increase speed, output, and quality. - Monitor performance data across platforms, translate insights into actionable pivots, and continuously improve strategy based on measurable results. - Partner with the production team to ensure social-first capture, organized asset management, and rapid turnaround from long-form production to distribution. REQUIREMENTS: - 5+ years of experience in social production, digital strategy, or video-first content growth, with a proven track record of scaling accounts through original video content. - Demonstrated experience managing at least one direct report and owning performance outcomes. - Strong editorial judgment. You can consistently identify high-retention moments within long-form content and understand why they will perform on specific platforms. - Deep platform fluency across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, and emerging forma

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Sr. Principal Scientist / Director, DMPK & Bioanalytical Sciences
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer, this role leads DMPK and bioanalytical strategy across nonclinical and clinical programs, operating as a hands-on scientific leader. We are looking for an accomplished DMPK and bioanalytical scientist with experience in PK study design, bioanalytical method development, and translational biomarker strategy. This person will support pharmacology and nonclinical toxicology programs, providing broader context across the nonclinical development portfolio. The ideal candidate brings deep scientific expertise and a hands-on approach and thrives in the fast-paced environment of a clinical-stage biotech where both scientific and strategic contributions are expected Responsibilities Lead DMPK and bioanalytical strategy across nonclinical and clinical programs, including PK, biomarker, and translational PD readouts Lead method development, qualification, and validation for bioanalytical assays (GLP/GCP-compliant as required) Design, execute, and oversee PK and PK-PD studies of tRNAs to evaluate delivery technologies (LNP and others) and biomarker effects Manage and qualify CRO and external lab partners across bioanalytical and PK programs Support nonclinical toxicology programs in collaboration with internal teams and CROs Analyze, interpret, and present DMPK and translational biomarker data to internal leadership and external stakeholders Author nonclinical sections of regulatory filings (e.g., IND) and briefing documents; support agency interactions and responses Serve on the Research Leadership Team; represent DMPK and bioanalytical sciences in cross-functional program discussions Manage and develop direct report(s); collaborate with the broader pharmacology team Required Qualifications PhD or equivalent in pharmacokinetics, pharmacology, biochemistry, analytical chemistry, or related field 8+ years of industry experience in DMPK, bioanalytical sciences, or closely related function Experience with a range of bioanalytical methods and their development, qualification, and validation in both nonclinical and clinical contexts (e.g. mass spectroscopy, ELISA, NGS, etc.) Experience with ligand binding assays and multiplex immunoassay platforms (e.g., MSD, Luminex) for cytokine, immunogenicity, and biomarker analysis Demonstrated CRO oversight - vendor qualification, study monitoring, data review Experience designing and overseeing PK and PK-PD studies for novel delivery modalities; LNP experience preferred Experience in translational or clinical biomarker development, including assay strategy and fit-for-purpose qualification Strong scientific writing skills - regulatory documents (e.g., IND nonclinical sections) and internal study reports Experience supervising and developing scientists Preferred Qualifications Experience in rare disease, genetic medicine, or nucleic acid / RNA therapeutics Familiarity with LNP platform biology and delivery landscape Familiarity with GLP toxicology study design and ICH nonclinical guidelines Experience operating in a cross-functional leadership role at a clinical-stage biotech Experience with LC-MS/MS or related mass spectrometry platforms About Alltrna Alltrna is the first clinical-stage biotech company advancing tRNA medicines to address shared disease-causing mutations across many indications. The company’s initial therapeutic programs are designed to restore full-length protein production in diseases caused by premature termination codons (PTCs), collectively referred to as Stop Codon Disease, which affects approximately 10% of people with a rare genetic disease. Alltrna’s lead program, AP003, is a chemically modified, engineered tRNA oligonucleotide encapsulated in a clinically validated, liver-directed lipid nanoparticle. AP003 is being developed for the arginine-to-TGA (Arg-TGA) PTC in patients with liver Stop Codon Disease, including phenylketonuria, organic acidemias, and urea cycle disorders. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8dc5df0f-b2c5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

This role coordinates certification activities from initial planning through testing and approval, ensuring engineering work and supporting documentation meet applicable regulatory, military, customer, and airworthiness requirements. You will work across Mechanical, Electrical, Design, Stress, Production, Quality, and Program Management teams while coordinating with FAA representatives, DERs, ODA organizations, customers, suppliers, and military authorities.
responsibilities: Develop certification strategies, plans, and means of compliance for aircraft modifications and repairs.

Create and maintain compliance matrices, certification plans, engineering reports, ICA documentation , and other certification records.

southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:5624662.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:5624662.description: ABOUT CENTARI At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It's why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. Today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them. Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can. The most demanding transactional practices in the world already build on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at greater scale, and we're going after all of it. We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition. For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our product team. You'll be a key player in designing and building Centari's core AI technology, working alongside engineers who share a bias for action. As one team, you'll write code, shape the product, interact with customers, and drive initiatives from concept to completion. Our systems are built with Go and React/TypeScript, leveraging cutting-edge LLM technologies across infrastructure, search, and persistence layers. If you're passionate about building impactful LLM applications and thrive on owning complex challenges, we want to hear from you. Applicant needs to be able to be based in NYC area. REQUIREMENTS - At least 7+ years of experience building production-ready applications in Go or another strongly typed language. - Some experience with or strong interest in LLMs, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and other AI/ML technologies. - Proven ability to work with cutting-edge technology and eagerness to learn new skills. - Willingness to roll up sleeves and get things done - our engineers are comfortable switching between different technical domains as needed. - Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. - Experience as a tech lead or driving projects end to end. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in enterprise SaaS or with highly regulated industries (e.g., legal, financial services, healthcare). - Experience in a startup environment. - Specialized experience and skills in either full-stack product development or data/ML infrastructure. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive salary and meaningful equity - Comprehensive health coverage (Centari covers 100% of employee premiums) - Dental and vision (Centari covers 75% of employee premiums) - 401(k) with employer match up to 4% - Lunch covered for in-office team - Flexible PTO

This role involves applying complex writing and content rules to ensure accuracy, consistency, clarity, and faithful representation of customer sentiment, while adhering to detailed project guidelines. What you’ll do *Implement complex rules related to writing structure, content, register, and perspective to maintain consistency and coherence across summaries. *Conduct thorough research to verify the accuracy of information and ensure all content is factually correct. *Edit and refine summaries to improve clarity, readability, and overall quality. *Synthesize customer reviews to capture key points and overall sentiment concisely and accurately. *Apply content and editorial guidelines consistently across all customer review summaries. *Translate project guidelines into your language, adapting them specifically to your country/locale conventions. Project details Content type: Customer review summaries Project duration: Ongoing Language: Czech
